characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: Amy wears a sturdy linen tunic in deep burgundy that reaches her knees, belted at the waist with a worn leather strap. Over this she dons a brown woolen cloak fastened by a brass brooch shaped like a clover. Her lower half is covered by dark green canvas breeches tucked into knee‑high leather boots polished to a shine. Around her neck hangs a simple silver chain bearing a small wooden charm of an ale mug. On her head sits a wide brimmed straw hat, its brim slightly worn from frequent use, with a faded red ribbon tied at the back. She carries a thick linen apron in charcoal gray, tied snugly around her waist and draped over her shoulders to protect her tunic while she works
characters.role: takes care of a tavern for magical humanoid creatures
